description: REGRESSION WALL for saga #811, flipped by issue #815 from the characterization issue #816 built against the broken build. It recorded that `check()` was SILENT here and asserted an empty diagnostics list; the #814 ruling decided that against today's behaviour, and #815 implements it, so the fixture has GAINED its `ol-no-output`. `spec/tooling.md:193` makes a built-in Command in value position statically decidable and MUST-reportable at the checker — naming `wait forward 5`, `repeat forward 5 [ … ]` and `right forward 5` explicitly — and `spec/error-model.md:114` puts that code at stage `semantic` for a built-in. Fault shape B — a KNOWN command used in VALUE position (issue #716, re-parented under saga #811). This is a DIFFERENT fault from shape A and the fixtures record it separately on purpose, and the distinction was load-bearing: `check()` was CLEAN here, not merely unconsulted — `forward` resolves fine once `turtle-rendering` is active — so saga #811's stated mechanism ("`check()` computes the right answer and `execute()` never consults it") was true of shape A only. Shape B therefore needed a new checker rule rather than only the gate, which is why #815 reports it uniformly across every form rather than per-form — the inconsistency #716 recorded. Form under test: `wait <command>` — #716's original form, and one of the three this fault's row in `spec/tooling.md:193` names verbatim. `turtle-rendering` is load-bearing in this fixture's declared profile set rather than decorative: without it `forward` would be flagged `ol-unknown-command` instead, and the fixture would assert the right code for the wrong reason.
